Other major speakers on Wednesday night included three of Trump's former opponents for the nomination, Wisconsin Governor Scott Walker, Florida Senator Marco Rubio, and Texas Senator Ted Cruz.

In many ways, Cruz stole the show, speaking much longer than scheduled and waxing eloquent about American freedom. "America is more than just a land mass between two oceans," Cruz told the convention audience. "America is an ideal.
